thread:
Sylvie: Heads-up — Nightingale Labs private rollout tonight during our quiet window. Proposal: pin model v2.3.1 on dedicated slice and proceed with canary rollout. We have a potential KMS rotation overlap reported by their infra team; need signoff to delay or shift the cutover.
Jordan: ACK. Is preflight green from DeployBot?
DeployBot: Preflight summary: model pin v2.3.1 applied; canary nodes healthy; KV cache primed. KMS rotation conflict detected (customer-side rotation at 23:30 UTC). Action recommended: delay customer rotation or move our cutover earlier. Logs: https://deploybot.internal/6338889990
Priya: Can we slide the cutover earlier by 30m to avoid the collision? Our rollback window is tight (30m).
Ops-QA: Canary metric snapshot: p50 +8% vs baseline, p99 +22%. Error rate 0.4%. Rollback thresholds are p99 > 50% above baseline OR error rate >1%. Current numbers are borderline but ok. Recommend conservative ramp: 5% x10m -> 25% x20m -> full.
Sylvie: Tradeoffs noted. I prefer avoiding customer KMS ops during our cutover. @Release-Council — do we want to push earlier or ask Nightingale to delay rotation?
Release-Council: Prefer to keep to late evening ops (daylight coverage). Suggest compromise: move cutover to 22:45 UTC so we finish before their 23:30 rotation. If Nightingale can delay rotation by 1hr that also works. Need explicit SRE confirmation.
Nightingale-SRE: We can delay KMS rotation to 00:30 UTC on request. Confirming with infra team now; will update in 10m.
Jordan: If rotation is delayed, can we keep 23:00? Ops-QA flags metrics as "within but close" — I'd like the conservative ramp Priya suggested. Also confirm pinned image/shas.
Sylvie: Agreed on ramp. Pinned model hash: abc12345. Worker image tag: rwinf/serve:v202603. Please include both in release notes and in the canary gating doc.
DeployBot: Scheduling update: final cutover set for 23:00 UTC with rollout plan: canary 5% for 10m -> increase to 25% for 20m -> full. KMS rotation: NIGHTINGALE requested delay to 00:30 UTC — conflict cleared. Automatic rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to abc12345`. Canary health checks: p99 latency threshold = 1.4x baseline; error-rate threshold = 0.8%.
Ops-QA: I'll watch dashboards and take action. If p99 exceeds 1.4x baseline OR error spikes >0.8% over a 5m window, I'll trigger rollback. @Sylvie @Jordan please ack standby.
Sylvie: :thumbsup: ack. I'll be on call and monitoring logs. Release notes updated with rollback criteria and pinned hashes.
Release-Council: Noted and recorded as "quiet window advisory". Please attach final preflight snapshot and the pinned artifacts to the release ticket.
Jordan: Quick config snippet for ops runbook (for the channel):
```
canary: 5%
canary_duration: 10m
ramp: 25% for 20m
full: then 100%
rollback_command: /deploy rollback --to abc12345
p99_threshold: 1.4x
error_threshold: 0.8%
image_tag: rwinf/serve:v202603
model_hash: abc12345
```
Priya: I'll be in the incident channel during the rollout and will validate responses.
DeployBot: Deploy started: canary at 5% initiated. Monitoring hooks live. Logs: https://deploybot.internal/6338890675
Ops-QA: Seeing expected traffic, p99 stable. Standing by.
Nightingale-SRE: Rotation delayed to 00:30 UTC as requested. Good luck — ping if you need key rotation assistance.
Sylvie: Thanks team. If anything deviates we roll back to abc12345.
